title: [Performance] Measure remaining pkgs/id test runtime targets after nextest

labels.name: effort/m
labels.description: Medium: expected under 1 day of work

labels.name: meta/enriched
labels.description: Intake review done: acceptance criteria, links, and normalized labels added

body:
Follow-up to the incomplete performance work on #6378. PR #8032 adopted `cargo-nextest` for `pkgs/id` recipes and shards, but the original issue was closed before its timing targets were measured.

## Evidence

- #6378 sets targets of unit tests under 2 minutes, integration tests under 5 minutes and E2E tests under 10 minutes; it also calls for NixOS VM test optimization and CI/CD optimization.
- PR #8032's recorded `cargo nextest run --all-features --lib` result is 3,468 tests in 132 seconds with a stub `web/dist` (one stub-only failure; the web tests passed after building real assets). This does not meet the 120-second unit target and does not measure integration, E2E, VM or full CI paths.
- The #6378 triage note #6737334164 explicitly left VM-test optimization and selective-by-path execution as later slices. A current issue search found no follow-up for those criteria.

## Scope

Measure current-main `pkgs/id` test and CI legs on remote Fleet runners with production-equivalent web assets. Record the exact command, commit SHA, run handle/URL, elapsed time and result for unit, integration, E2E and NixOS VM tests, plus the PR CI path. Compare each result with #6378's thresholds and separate build/setup time from test execution time.

For each missed target, file and enqueue a separately scoped implementation issue with the measured bottleneck and a runnable done check. Preserve full test coverage; do not remove or weaken tests to meet a timing target.

## Acceptance

- Remote run evidence is recorded for every available test class and the CI path; an unavailable leg has its exact blocker recorded.
- The results state whether the #6378 targets pass or miss on current main.
- Every missed target has a scoped follow-up issue and live queue task, or the evidence proves all targets are already met.
